plugins.name: cloud
plugins.description: Lead, worker, reader, test author and retro skills for running batches of GitHub issues in Claude Code cloud sessions. Needs the github plugin from the same marketplace. No hooks.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: The pull-request skill: take a GitHub pull request from open to merged, from your own machine or from a Claude Code cloud session. No hooks; the local route calls read-only scripts shipped with the skill.

plugins.name: mise
plugins.description: Installs the tools a repository pins with mise when a session starts, and puts them on PATH. Runs a SessionStart hook: one script, which only installs what the repository's own mise.toml names.
